{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales['revenue_float'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for invalid conversions again
invalid_count = sales['revenue_float'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue conversions after cleaning: {invalid_count}")

# Identify the 6 internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")
print("QA order IDs:")
print(qa_orders['order_id'])

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
completed_orders = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
